description: This file contains a Java class 'ReadableProductReviewPopulator' that extends 'AbstractDataPopulator' to convert 'ProductReview' objects into 'ReadableProductReview' objects, populating fields such as date, customer info, rating, product ID, and review description.

classes.name: ReadableProductReviewPopulator
classes.description: A Java class that populates ReadableProductReview objects from ProductReview sources.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a ReadableProductReview object with data from a ProductReview source, including customer info, date, rating, product ID, and description.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ReadableProductReview (currently returns null).
